decia.demoHint: Fictional demo data: the decisions API does not exist yet and everything lives only in this browser tab.
decia.confidence.label: Confidence
decia.confidence.help: Confidence {pct} — how likely do you believe this outcome is? Stated by the owner, not calculated.
decia.confidence.helpNoPct: How likely the owner believes it will work. Stated by a person (5% steps), never calculated, and different from evidence strength.
decia.readiness.check.question: Decision question defined (15+ characters, ends with “?”)
decia.readiness.check.evidence: Critical evidence (moderate or strong for the leading option)
decia.readiness.check.assumptions: Critical assumptions addressed and not invalidated
decia.readiness.check.risks: Risks assessed for the leading option
decia.ai.unavailable: AI analysis unavailable — the matrix keeps working
decia.card.overconfident: Confidence above what the record supports
decia.next.evidence: Add evidence for the leading option
decia.next.question: Write the decision question
decia.next.risks: Assess the risks of the leading option
decia.matrix.invalidWeight: Invalid weight: use values from 0 to 100 for every criterion
decia.matrix.sumBad: Weights add up to {sum}% — adjust to 100%
decia.matrix.scaleHint: Scores from 1 to 5: 5 is always the most desirable (Cost: 5 = cheapest). Consensus = median.
decia.compare.noAlternatives: A real decision compares options — including doing nothing.
decia.compare.noCriteria: Which criteria matter for this question?
decia.compare.lockedAfterDecision: Decision finalized: the matrix is read-only. To change scores or weights, reopen the decision (the decision-time snapshot is preserved).
decia.compare.matrixNeedsAlternatives: Add alternatives to fill the matrix.
decia.compare.independentNote: Independent round: each person rated before seeing the others' median.
decia.sensitivity.robust: Robust: no weight change flips the lead
decia.sensitivity.sensitive: Sensitive recommendation: a change of up to 10 pp flips the lead
decia.sensitivity.moderate: Flips only with changes above 10 pp
decia.sensitivity.flip: If {criterion} goes from {from}% to {to}%, {alt} takes the lead.
decia.timeline.title: Timeline
decia.guard.title: Decide
decia.guard.block.SEM_RESPONSAVEL: The decision needs a human owner.
decia.guard.warn.PRONTIDAO_INCOMPLETA: Readiness is not yet “ready to decide”.
decia.guard.warn.PREMISSA_CRITICA_NAO_VA: There is an unvalidated critical assumption.
decia.guard.confirm: I read the warnings and still want to decide (recorded in the trail)
decia.guard.snapshotNote: On confirm, what is known now is frozen in an immutable snapshot with a SHA-256 hash.
decia.decision.rationaleHint: Why this option? At least 10 characters.
decia.decision.noRecommendation: No recommendation: the matrix has no leader yet.
decia.decision.snapshot: At the time of the decision
decia.decision.snapshotNote: Immutable record (read only): later changes never rewrite the past.
decia.decision.differs: The current state differs from the one recorded at decision time.
decia.decision.noSnapshot: Not decided yet — the snapshot is written when the decision is confirmed.
decia.challenge.title: Challenge the decision
decia.challenge.desc: AI critiques the structure (it does not echo the choice) and never decides for you.
decia.challenge.notConnected: The AI service is not connected in this version yet.
decia.challenge.unavailableDetail: “{mode}” could not run. The matrix, sensitivity and guard keep working without AI.
decia.form.doNothingHint: Doing nothing is a first-class alternative.
decia.evidence.contraryNote: Counter-evidence is never hidden; opinion counts half; superseded evidence does not count.
decia.execution.notDecidedDesc: Plan, checkpoints, outcome and retrospective appear once the decision is recorded.
decia.execution.brier: Brier score of these forecasts: {value} (n = {n}) — lower is better
decia.execution.calibrationHidden: Calibration only appears with {n} or more resolved forecasts — and never becomes a personal score.
decia.execution.noOutcomeCheckpoint: The outcome cannot be observed yet. Checkpoint on {date}.
decia.execution.noOutcome: The outcome cannot be observed yet.
decia.execution.retroAfterOutcome: The retrospective comes after the outcome.
decia.quadrant.good.bad: Good decision, bad outcome — the process was sound
decia.quadrant.bad.good: Weak process, good outcome — luck is not a method
decia.ws.onlyOwner: Only the decision owner can decide.
decia.ws.notInMemory: Decision not found in this tab
decia.ws.notInMemoryDesc: Decisions created in the demo live only in the tab's memory and disappear on reload.
decia.note.title: Context note
decia.note.procurement: Institutional procurement follows the applicable public purchasing rules (for example, tender, waiver or sole-source). This record organizes the analysis; it does not replace the formal process or legal advice.
decia.overview.question: Question
decia.overview.noAggregate: No overall score: each component is shown separately, on purpose.
decia.complexityHint.RAPIDA: Question, 2 options, key criterion, choice and rationale.
decia.complexityHint.PADRAO: + context, criteria, matrix and at least 1 piece of evidence.
decia.complexityHint.PROFUNDA: + weights, sensitivity, risks, assumptions and forecasts.
decia.divergence.signal: High divergence is a signal, not noise: hear those who disagree before deciding.
decia.risks.title: Risks
decia.risks.emptyRisks: No risks assessed — risk stays “not assessed”, never low by omission.
decia.risks.matrixNote: Numbers = open risks in each cell. Severity is calculated, never typed.
decia.inbox.emptyDesc: When a decision needs your choice, evidence or a review, it shows up here.
decia.reviews.emptyDesc: Outcomes to record and retrospectives show up here after decisions.
decia.new.title: New decision
decia.new.desc: Start with the question. Alternatives, criteria and evidence come in the workspace.
decia.new.question: Decision question
decia.new.questionHint: End with “?” — e.g. Which support vendor should we hire?
decia.new.questionError: Write a question with at least 15 characters ending in “?”.
